54b188da-ae48-4ad5-85bf-fc5a7502eb58.line: 在天台吃完面包看了会儿书，没人打扰挺好的。

items.imgPrompt: pastel-colored yarn balls and bamboo knitting needles in a woven basket, on a wooden desk beside a window, soft natural light, slightly used

desc.zh: 圍巾已經織好了……剩下的毛線和針就不需要了。那條圍巾，是給很重要的人的。
desc.zh_cn: 围巾已经织好了……剩下的毛线和针就不需要了。那条围巾，是给很重要的人的。
desc.en: The scarf is finished... so I don't need the leftover yarn and needles anymore. That scarf was for someone very important to me.

items.imgPrompt: small pastel pink locked diary with a tiny silver key, resting on a white bedsheet, barely any wear, soft bedroom lighting

desc.zh: 只寫了幾頁就……有些話，果然還是想直接說出口比較好。
desc.zh_cn: 只写了几页就……有些话，果然还是想直接说出口比较好。
desc.en: I only wrote a few pages before stopping... some things are better said out loud, after all.

items.imgPrompt: assorted ribbon hair clips in soft pink and white on a small wooden tray, bedroom vanity background, slight wear on metal clasps

desc.zh: 買太多了……其實每天都只戴同一個。才、才不是因為那個是誰送的……
desc.zh_cn: 买太多了……其实每天都只戴同一个。才、才不是因为那个是谁送的……
desc.en: I bought too many... I actually only wear the same one every day. I-it's not because someone special gave me that one or anything...

items.imgPrompt: silicone cookie baking mold set with star flower and heart shapes, on a kitchen countertop, light flour residue, warm kitchen lighting

desc.zh: 一整套買回來，結果只用了心形的那個……不、不要問我為什麼。
desc.zh_cn: 一整套买回来，结果只用了心形的那个……不、不要问我为什么。
desc.en: Bought the whole set, but I only ever used the heart-shaped one... d-don't ask me why.

items.imgPrompt: cream-colored stuffed rabbit plush sitting on a neatly made bed with light blue sheets, slight compression on fur, gentle afternoon light

desc.zh: 這個是別人送的……但我已經有更珍貴的東西了，所以沒關係的。
desc.zh_cn: 这个是别人送的……但我已经有更珍贵的东西了，所以没关系的。
desc.en: Someone gave this to me... but I already have something far more precious, so it's okay to let it go.

items.imgPrompt: pastel pink instant film camera on a white desk beside a small potted plant, pristine condition with no scratches, soft diffused window light

desc.zh: 想拍下一些想留住的瞬間……但每次舉起來就害羞了。幾乎沒用過。
desc.zh_cn: 想拍下一些想留住的瞬间……但每次举起来就害羞了。几乎没用过。
desc.en: I wanted to capture moments I never want to forget... but I got too shy every time I raised it. Barely used.
